name: ON_SIDE_ROAD_YELLOWGREEN_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W8-SA3: W8-SA3B 750 x 500 illustrated (A 600 x 400, C 900 x 600, D 1200 x 800; PNG W8-SA3A.png), fluorescent yellow-green, R50, 10 / 30. The AS 1743 W8-3 layout on FYG: ON 100 D baseline 170, 161 (294/161/295); SIDE 236 + 70 + ROAD 276, 100 C, baseline 314 (84/236/70/276/84); arrow 400 long (175/400/175), centre line 105 from the bottom, head 100 x 92, shaft 29 at the head (9 notch), R5 — drawn as the national W8-3 polygon. (L) drawn; (R) mirrors the arrow.
